card.title: Join Me
card.instruction: Recruit someone into a secret plan.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Will you keep Mum in the kitchen while I hide her birthday cake?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Only if you stop telling her I'm the one who plans these things.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: This one's mine. Could you ask her to show you her pastry trick?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She'll make me bake a whole pie.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll peel the apples tonight. Could you get us twenty minutes and a pie?

mechanism: A recruits B to conceal a birthday cake by bargaining away blame and reducing the cost of a distraction.
confusable: Unlike merely planning a surprise alone, A must secure another person's specific covert role.
comparison: D07-a offers apple preparation to support a kitchen distraction; D07-b offers spreadsheet work to free a colleague for a coffee diversion.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
